app-title: Hub ya Dyondzo ya Vapayona va Afrika - Handle
welcome-sub: Nyango yo Tiyisa Afrika hi Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Eku tlangeleni Siku ra Afrika ra 25, Nongonoko lowu wa Vuleteri bya Pi Pioneers wu simekiwile)
intro-p1: Pi Network i mali ya xidijithali na projeke ya ecosystem ya misava hinkwayo leyi endleriweke ku endla leswaku cryptocurrency yi kumeka naswona yi pfuna eka un'wana na un'wana.
intro-p2: Ku hambana na ti-cryptocurrencies ta ndhavuko leti lavaka michini yo yima ya mali yo durha, Pi Network yi pfumelela vanhu va ntolovelo ku nghenelela hi ku kongoma ku suka eka tifoni ta vona.
intro-list:
• Aka ikhonomi ya xidijithali leyi katsaka un'wana na un'wana
  • Tiyisa vanhu va ntolovelo emisaveni hinkwayo
  • Engetela matirhiselo ya ntiyiso
  • Seketela mabindzu ya munhu na munhu
ch1: NDZIMA YA 1 — KU TSARISA & KU SUNGULA
ch1-p1: Goza ra 1: Dawuniloda Pi Network - Tirhisa xihlanganisi: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Goza ra 2: Tsarisa hi Facebook kumbe Foni → Nghenisa khodi: CHIGALEX1 → Kuma hakelo ya 1 Pi
ch1-p3: Ku Ceriwa ka Siku na Siku: Vuya hinkwato 24 wa tiawara u klika buton ya rihati ku yisa emahlweni ku cera.
ch1-list:
• Endla chikwama xa Pi hi vuhlayiseki
  • Hetisa 2FA
  • Hetisa KYC
  • Tilulamisela ku rhurha ka Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Vuhlayiseki bya chikwama: U NGA tshuki u avelana marito ya wena ya 24 ya passphrase! Ntlawa wa Pi Core A WU NGA tshuki wu ku kombela!
ch2: NDZIMA YA 2 — DYONDZO YA CHIKWAMA XA PI
ch2-p1: Chikwama xa wena xa Pi i bangi ya wena eka Pi Ecosystem. Xi khoma mali ya wena ya Pi hi vuhlayiseki eka blockchain.
ch2-p2: Ndlela yo tumbuluxa: Pfula Pi Browser → Wallet → Endla Wallet → KOPIYA marito ya wena ya 24 → Hlayisa offline eka tindhawu ti-2 leti hlayisekeke.
ch2-p3: Ku Amukela Pi: Avelana adirese ya wena ya vaaki (yi sungula hi G...). Ku Rhumela Pi: Namarheta adirese ya muamukeri, nghenisa mali, tiyisisa.
ch2a-p1: Leswi tirhaka: Sungula hi mali leyitsongo ya xilingo (1 Pi). Tiyisisa maletere ya 4 yo sungula na ya 4 yo hetelela ya adirese ya fana. U nga tshuki u namarheta passphrase ya wena eka webusayiti yihi na yihi!
ch3: NDZIMA YA 3 — KU TWISISA PI ECOSYSTEM
ch3-p1: Pi Browser yi fana na Google Play Store ya Pi. Ti-DApps ti application leti hangalasiweke ta matirhiselo ya ntiyiso — ku xava, dyondzo, mintlangu, vukorhokeri hinkwabyo hi Pi.
ch4: NDZIMA YA 4 — MAPOFPI & KU HLANGANISIWA KA BINDZU
ch4-p1: Kuma mabindzu lama amukelaka Pi emisaveni hinkwayo eka mapofpi.com. Tsarisa bindzu ra wena u sungula ku amukela Pi ya nhundzu na vukorhokeri.
ch5-p1: Ntsengo wa Ntwanano wa Misava (GCV) wu hlohlotela matirhiselo ya ntiyiso. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Ntsengo lowu wu akiwile hi vapayona lava tirhisaka Pi eka mabindzu ya ntiyiso.
ch6-p1: Dyondza manyuwali ya Doris Yin ya ku tumbuluxa matirhiselo na ku kula ka ecosystem. Lavisisa, dyondza, u dyondzisa van'wana — hi ndlela leyi hi tiyisaka Afrika ha yona.
final-msg: Afrika yi na minkarhi yo va yin'wana ya swifundza swa matimba eka matirhiselo lama tirhaka endzeni ka Pi Ecosystem. Hi Ntlangu Hi Aka. Hi Ntlangu Hi Dyondzisa.
